notes: Fixes saved Raid and Reaper death-timer values not being kept, stops the popup reappearing after shutdown, and reads accounts.json once instead of several times a second. Also restart-safe: the Plugin Hub can now restart it every 10 minutes (change or turn off on the hub's Diagnostics page) so long sessions stay smooth, and settings and progress carry over. Settings files are now saved safely, so a crash can no longer reset them.
